name: files
title: Files
description: Find a file or folder anywhere under your home, then open it, browse it, or copy its path.
author: lumanin

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.description: Type a name to find files and folders under your home.

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.title: Hidden Files
preferences.label: Include dotfiles and dot-directories
preferences.description: Off by default: a home directory is mostly .cache and .local, and they drown out what you were looking for.

preferences.name: tool
preferences.title: Search With
preferences.description: Leave on Automatic unless you have a reason. Automatic prefers fd, then plocate, then a plain find.
